name: Dark Star Thresh × Dota 2 Killstreaks Announcer
creator: dear-agony
description:
### Overview

This mod uses the original Dark Star Thresh announcer combined with killstreak and multikill voice lines from Dota 2.

Imported voice lines were adjusted to better fit League's announcer system.

---

### Dark Star Thresh announcements

**General**

• Welcome to Summoner's Rift  
• Minions have spawned  
• Summoner disconnected / reconnected  
• Victory / Defeat  

**Combat**

• Ally slain  
• Enemy slain  
• You have slain an enemy  
• You have been slain  
• Executed  
• Shutdown  
• Ace  

**Objectives**

• Turret destroyed  
• Turret lost  
• Inhibitor destroyed  
• Inhibitor lost  
• Inhibitor respawn announcements  

---

### Dota 2 killstreak & multikill announcements

*(original League announcements → Dota 2 replacements)*

**Multikills**

• First Blood → First Blood!      
• Double Kill → Double Kill!      
• Triple Kill → Triple Kill!      
• Quadra Kill → Ultra Kill!      
• Penta Kill → Rampage!     

**Killstreaks**

• Killing Spree → Killing Spree!     
• Rampage → Mega Kill!      

*(Dota 2 Rampage was intentionally NOT used here because in Dota 2 it represents a Pentakill-equivalent killstreak rather than a regular streak tier.)*    

• Dominating → Dominating!      
• Unstoppable → Unstoppable!      
• Godlike → Godlike! / Monster Kill!      
• Legendary → Ownage! / Holy Shit! / Wicked Sick!
